title: List of Businesses Without Websites: Find Them by Industry & City (2026)

facts.fact: The vendor (B2BLeadFinder) states that the article was published on 2026-04-22.
The vendor estimates that 45–55% of landscaping and gardening businesses have no website.
The vendor estimates that 40–50% of cleaning services businesses have no website.
The vendor estimates that 35–45% of independent restaurants have no website.
The vendor estimates that 10–20% of dentists and clinics have no website.
The vendor states that plumbers, electricians, and HVAC engineers have high average transaction values of £500–£5,000 per job.
facts.quote: have high average transaction values (£500–£5,000 per job)

facts.fact: The vendor claims that 55–65% of listed businesses in Mumbai, Delhi, and Bangalore have no website.
facts.quote: India: Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore — 55–65% of listed businesses have no website

facts.fact: The vendor claims that 60–70% of businesses in Jakarta, Manila, and Bangkok have no website.
The vendor claims that 45–55% of businesses in Mexico City and São Paulo have no website.
facts.quote: Latin America: Mexico City, São Paulo — 45–55%

facts.fact: The vendor says the manual Google Maps method takes about 4 minutes per lead and yields about 15 leads per hour.
facts.value: 4 min per lead; ~15 leads per hour
facts.unit: minutes per lead; leads per hour

facts.fact: The vendor claims its B2BLeadFinder scanner produces about 50 leads in about 2 minutes.
The vendor states that the Google Places API returns a website field, and an empty or null value indicates the business has no website.
facts.quote: Fields returned include `website` — if this field is empty or null, the business has no website.

facts.fact: The vendor states that most local business owners need 3–5 touchpoints before they buy.
facts.quote: Most local business owners need 3–5 touchpoints before they buy.

facts.fact: The vendor recommends a follow-up sequence of initial outreach, then a 3-day follow-up, a 7-day value add, and a 14-day final message.
facts.quote: initial outreach → 3-day follow-up → 7-day value add (send their Digital Health Report) → 14-day final.
